heading: Commission Approves Conditional Offers for Four Police Officers
category: Sun Prairie Police and Fire Commission
summary: The Sun Prairie Police and Fire Commission approved conditional employment offers for four police officers at its Nov 18 special meeting. The motion listed Dec 14, 2026, as the start date for all four candidates. All three commissioners present voted in favor after the commission returned from a closed session on police hiring.

heading: Wisconsin Sues TikTok Over Alleged Harm to Children
summary: Wisconsin Attorney General Josh Kaul announced a lawsuit alleging that TikTok uses addictive features that harm children while misleading parents about the app's risks. The suit, filed in Dane County Circuit Court, challenges features including infinite scrolling, autoplay and push notifications. It alleges violations of Wisconsin's deceptive trade practices and public nuisance laws. The Department of Justice said the lawsuit follows a bipartisan multistate investigation.

heading: Wisconsin Projects $4.18 Billion General Fund Balance
source: Wisconsin Department of Administration press release
summary: The Wisconsin Department of Administration projects a gross general fund balance of about $4.18 billion at the end of the 2026-27 fiscal year. The estimate is separate from the approximately $2.1 billion in the state's budget stabilization fund. Updated tax estimates put revenue at $24.55 billion for 2026-27, a 6.1% increase over the prior fiscal year. The department said the estimates reflect current state and federal tax laws and exclude agency budget requests.

heading: Wisconsin Receives Another $203 Million for Rural Health Program
summary: The Wisconsin Department of Health Services said the state received more than $203 million for a second year of its Rural Health Transformation Program. The program supports rural health workers, technology and partnerships to coordinate care. In its first year, DHS awarded more than $70 million to 122 grantees and provided nearly $80 million to 16 implementation partners for workforce initiatives. The agency also used first-year funding to develop an optional statewide electronic health record system for rural providers. DHS said care coordination planning grants would be awarded in the coming weeks.
